neutralVersionBoundary: Parent coordinates optional neutral-render versions. A neutral material/rendering study can be linked to an existing project mask without converting uncertain identity, source lighting or invented geometry into certified franchise truth. No generation performed here before storage signal.
conclusion: No new qualifying film/comics mask image recovered in this research pass. Preserve open targets and source distinctions; exact final-film/comics geometry still requires identified primary panels/stills or a separately qualified secondary source.
